20261122-chemistry-g06-1.title: Advanced reaction reasoning
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.goal: Apply the principles of Advanced reaction reasoning to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.material: [Advanced reaction reasoning] Dem dey drop dilute hydrochloric acid small small with dropper inside sodium hydroxide solution (wey dey turn red litmus paper blue) and dey mix am. Wen dem add enough hydrochloric acid, which change for di mixed solution na correct?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced reaction reasoning] Dem dey drop dilute hydrochloric acid small small with dropper inside sodium hydroxide solution (wey dey turn red litmus paper blue) and dey mix am. Wen dem add enough hydrochloric acid, which change for di mixed solution na correct?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.explain: Wen acid (hydrochloric acid) and base (sodium hydroxide) react, water and salt dey form, and heat of neutralization dey release so temperature go rise. If dem add too much hydrochloric acid, di whole solution go become acidic and e go turn blue litmus paper red.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: For neutralization reaction, heat of neutralization dey produce and temperature dey rise.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.1: If dem add too much hydrochloric acid, e go become acidic solution.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o0: Heat dey produce and temperature rise, and di final solution turn blue litmus paper red
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o1: Di solution suddenly turn cold and freeze become ice
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o2: No reaction dey happen and e remain as e be
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o3: Only hydrogen gas dey produce explosively

20261122-chemistry-g06-2.title: Wen big bush fire dey spread come
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.topic: Wen big bush fire dey spread come
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.goal: Apply the principles of Wen big bush fire dey spread come to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.material: Wen big bush fire dey spread come, dem dey cut plenty trees for front of di fire path with chainsaw to build 'firebreak'. Which among di three elements of combustion dis one dey remove?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.thinking.0: Wen big bush fire dey spread come
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: Wen big bush fire dey spread come, dem dey cut plenty trees for front of di fire path with chainsaw to build 'firebreak'. Which among di three elements of combustion dis one dey remove?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.explain: Dis na di removal principle of putting out fire: dem remove 'fuel', wey be one of di essential elements of combustion, before, so no fuel go dey for di path wey di flame dey spread come, and di spread of di bush fire go stop.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.hint.0: For fire to burn, di fuel must continue to connect.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.hint.1: If you remove di trees before, fire no go get where to jump go again.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.o.o2: Lower di temperature below di ignition point
